name: Nomad Ground
description: Where the people who still cross put their tents.
arrival: Felt tents on the shingle above the ford, guyed low, with the fire in the middle and the animals downstream of it. Nobody has pitched anywhere near the rail-head, which has a roof and a water butt and is a mile off.
notes: Sited at the ford rather than the rail-head, deliberately and legibly. The nomads use the crossing the Vedda used and ignore the one the machine age built, because a ford needs no timetable and a river takes animals.
